The Fraud Evidence Evaluation Process includes the Customer Dispute Claim Assessment as its first step
context: For Each Piece of Evidence, Score: Customer Disputes Transaction | 1–3 | 1=Weak claim, 3=Strong claim (backed by facts)

description: Customer Dispute Claim Assessment is followed by Geographic Impossibility Check in the evaluation sequence
context: Evidence evaluation steps: Customer Disputes Transaction, then Geo-Impossibility, then Device Mismatch, etc.

description: Geographic Impossibility Check is followed by Device Mismatch Evaluation
context: Geo-Impossibility | 0–2 | 2=Confirmed impossible, 0=Possible; Device Mismatch | 0–2 | 2=New device, 0=Known device

description: Device Mismatch Evaluation is followed by Merchant Risk Classification
context: Device Mismatch | 0–2, then Merchant Risk | 0–2 | 2=High-risk merchant, 0=Legitimate

description: Merchant Risk Classification is followed by Transaction Velocity Analysis
context: Merchant Risk | 0–2, then Velocity | 0–2 | 2=Multiple rapid transactions, 0=Single

description: Transaction Velocity Analysis is followed by Customer History Pattern Review
context: Velocity | 0–2, then Customer History | 0–2 | 2=Customer never does this, 0=Typical

description: Customer History Pattern Review is followed by Fraud Score Calculation
context: Customer History | 0–2, then Fraud Score = Sum of Evidence Points (0–12)

description: Fraud Score Calculation leads to the Fraud Score Outcome Gate decision point
context: Fraud Score = Sum of Evidence Points (0–12); Score | Assessment | Action

description: Fraud Score Outcome Gate routes to Fraud Investigation Trigger when score is 7–12 (Fraud Confirmed or Likely)
context: 10–12 | Fraud Confirmed | Refund + Investigation; 7–9 | Fraud Likely | Refund + Investigation

description: Fraud Score Outcome Gate routes to Fraud Possible Further Investigation when score is 4–6
context: 4–6 | Fraud Possible | Investigate further or refund pending

description: Fraud Score Outcome Gate routes to Customer Education on Fraud Unlikely when score is 1–3

properties.action: Likely authorized or error; educate customer

context: 1–3 | Fraud Unlikely | Likely authorized or error; educate customer

target_name: Fraud Claim Denial with Customer Education
description: Fraud Score Outcome Gate routes to Fraud Claim Denial with Customer Education when score is 0
context: 0 | Fraud Not Likely | Deny fraud claim; educate customer

description: Customer Dispute Claim Assessment reviews the disputed transaction as evidence
context: Customer Disputes Transaction | 1–3 | 1=Weak claim, 3=Strong claim (backed by facts)

description: Geographic Impossibility Check evaluates the disputed transaction for geographic inconsistencies
context: Geo-Impossibility | 0–2 | 2=Confirmed impossible, 0=Possible

description: Device Mismatch Evaluation assesses the disputed transaction for device inconsistencies
context: Device Mismatch | 0–2 | 2=New device, 0=Known device

description: Merchant Risk Classification evaluates the merchant associated with the disputed transaction
context: Merchant Risk | 0–2 | 2=High-risk merchant, 0=Legitimate

description: Transaction Velocity Analysis evaluates the disputed transaction within the context of transaction frequency patterns
context: Velocity | 0–2 | 2=Multiple rapid transactions, 0=Single

description: Customer History Pattern Review evaluates the disputed transaction against the customer's historical behavior
context: Customer History | 0–2 | 2=Customer never does this, 0=Typical

description: Fraud Investigation Trigger alert is raised on the disputed transaction when fraud score is 7–12
context: 10–12 | Fraud Confirmed | Refund + Investigation; 7–9 | Fraud Likely | Refund + Investigation

description: Fraud Possible Further Investigation alert is raised on the disputed transaction when fraud score is 4–6
context: 4–6 | Fraud Possible | Investigate further or refund pending

description: The Fraud Evidence Evaluation Process operates on the disputed transaction to assess fraud likelihood
context: Step 4: Evidence Evaluation - Assess Fraud Likelihood for disputed transactions
